features.name: daily_return
features.meaning: Absolute day-over-day price change.
features.interpretation: Positive = price rose today; negative = price fell.
features.limitations: Not scale-invariant across tickers/time — use pct_return for comparisons.
features.when_to_use: Feature for models trained on a single ticker over a stable price range.

features.name: pct_return
features.meaning: Percentage day-over-day return.
features.interpretation: Scale-invariant version of daily_return; comparable across tickers/time.
features.limitations: Can be noisy for low-priced/illiquid tickers.
features.when_to_use: Default target/feature basis for return-based modeling.

features.name: log_return
features.meaning: Log return; approximately additive over time (log_return sums across days approximate the multi-day log return).
features.interpretation: Near-zero = flat; symmetric around 0 for up/down moves of similar magnitude.
features.advantages: Time-additive, closer to normally distributed than raw pct returns; preferred by ARIMA/DL.
features.limitations: Less intuitive to read directly than pct_return.
features.when_to_use: Time series models (ARIMA/SARIMA) and DL sequence inputs.

features.name: price_diff
features.meaning: Intraday price change.
features.interpretation: Positive = the session closed above where it opened (net buying pressure that day).

features.name: open_close_diff
features.meaning: Alias of price_diff, kept as a distinct named column per spec for readability in reports.
features.interpretation: Same as price_diff.

features.name: high_low_diff
features.meaning: Intraday trading range (absolute).
features.interpretation: Larger values indicate a more volatile session.
features.when_to_use: Cheap proxy for intraday volatility alongside ATR.

features.name: typical_price
features.meaning: A single representative price for the session, weighting close, high and low equally.
features.interpretation: Commonly used as the input series for VWAP/CCI-style indicators.

features.name: median_price
features.meaning: Midpoint of the day's range, ignoring open/close.
features.interpretation: A smoother range-center reference than close alone.

features.name: weighted_close
features.meaning: Typical price with double weight on the close.
features.interpretation: Emphasizes the closing price, which usually carries the most information.

features.name: sma_5
features.meaning: 5-day Simple Moving Average.
features.interpretation: Price above SMA = uptrend bias; below = downtrend bias. Longer windows = smoother, laggier.
features.advantages: Simple, robust, widely understood baseline trend measure.
features.limitations: Lags price by ~2 days; whipsaws in sideways markets.
features.when_to_use: Trend-following features, crossover signals (see golden_cross/death_cross).

features.name: sma_10
features.meaning: 10-day Simple Moving Average.
features.interpretation: Price above SMA = uptrend bias; below = downtrend bias. Longer windows = smoother, laggier.
features.advantages: Simple, robust, widely understood baseline trend measure.
features.limitations: Lags price by ~5 days; whipsaws in sideways markets.
features.when_to_use: Trend-following features, crossover signals (see golden_cross/death_cross).

features.name: sma_20
features.meaning: 20-day Simple Moving Average.
features.interpretation: Price above SMA = uptrend bias; below = downtrend bias. Longer windows = smoother, laggier.

features.limitations: Lags price by ~10 days; whipsaws in sideways markets.
features.when_to_use: Trend-following features, crossover signals (see golden_cross/death_cross).

features.meaning: 50-day Simple Moving Average.

features.limitations: Lags price by ~25 days; whipsaws in sideways markets.

features.advantages: Simple, robust, widely understood baseline trend measure.
features.limitations: Lags price by ~100 days; whipsaws in sideways markets.
features.when_to_use: Trend-following features, crossover signals (see golden_cross/death_cross).

features.name: ema_5
features.meaning: 5-day Exponential Moving Average.
features.interpretation: Reacts faster to recent price changes than the equivalent SMA.
features.advantages: More responsive to new information than SMA; underlies MACD.
features.limitations: More sensitive to short-term noise/whipsaws than SMA.
features.when_to_use: Faster trend signal, or as an input to MACD-style features.

features.limitations: More sensitive to short-term noise/whipsaws than SMA.
features.when_to_use: Faster trend signal, or as an input to MACD-style features.

features.name: golden_cross
features.meaning: Bullish long-term trend-change signal (classically 50-day crossing above 200-day).
features.interpretation: True on the single day the fast SMA first exceeds the slow SMA.
features.advantages: Well-known, widely referenced signal; easy to explain to end users.
features.limitations: Lagging by construction (needs the crossover to already happen); frequent false signals in choppy markets.
features.when_to_use: Long-horizon regime/trend-change feature, not short-term timing.

features.name: death_cross
features.meaning: Bearish long-term trend-change signal.
features.interpretation: True on the single day the fast SMA first drops below the slow SMA.
features.limitations: Same lag/false-signal caveats as golden_cross.
features.when_to_use: Long-horizon regime/trend-change feature.

features.name: rsi
features.formula: 100 - 100/(1 + RS), RS = Wilder-smoothed avg gain / avg loss over 14 days
features.meaning: Relative Strength Index — bounded 0-100 momentum oscillator.
features.interpretation: Traditionally >70 = overbought, <30 = oversold; divergence from price can signal reversals.
features.advantages: Bounded scale makes it comparable across tickers/time; well-studied.
features.limitations: Can stay 'overbought'/'oversold' for extended periods in strong trends (false signals).
features.when_to_use: Overbought/oversold screening; confirming momentum alongside MACD.

features.name: roc
features.meaning: Rate of Change — percentage price change over the lookback period.
features.interpretation: Positive and rising = accelerating upward momentum.
features.when_to_use: Momentum feature comparable in scale across tickers.

features.name: momentum
features.meaning: Absolute price momentum over the lookback period.
features.interpretation: Magnitude and direction of the recent price move.
features.limitations: Not scale-invariant across tickers — prefer roc/price_momentum for cross-ticker models.

features.name: price_momentum
features.meaning: Percentage version of `momentum`.
features.interpretation: Scale-invariant momentum measure.

features.name: volume_momentum
features.meaning: Change in trading volume over the lookback period.
features.interpretation: Rising volume momentum alongside price momentum supports trend conviction.
features.when_to_use: Confirming price moves with participation (volume) — see also breakout features.

features.name: true_range
features.meaning: The full price range a bar covered, including any gap from the prior close.
features.interpretation: Larger values indicate a more volatile session, including overnight gaps.
features.when_to_use: Building block for ATR; on its own, a per-bar volatility snapshot.

features.name: atr
features.meaning: Average True Range — smoothed measure of typical daily trading range.
features.interpretation: Rising ATR = expanding volatility regime; commonly used to size stop-losses.
features.advantages: Captures gap risk (unlike a plain High-Low range); industry-standard.
features.limitations: Lagging (smoothed); doesn't indicate direction, only magnitude.
features.when_to_use: Risk/position-sizing features, volatility-regime detection.

features.name: historical_volatility
features.meaning: Annualized historical volatility from log returns.
features.interpretation: Directly comparable across tickers and to option-implied volatility.
features.when_to_use: Risk scoring, cross-ticker volatility comparison.

features.name: rolling_volatility_10
features.meaning: 10-day rolling standard deviation of daily percentage returns.
features.interpretation: Higher = choppier recent price action.

features.name: rolling_volatility_20
features.meaning: 20-day rolling standard deviation of daily percentage returns.
features.interpretation: Higher = choppier recent price action.

features.name: rolling_volatility_30
features.meaning: 30-day rolling standard deviation of daily percentage returns.
features.interpretation: Higher = choppier recent price action.

features.name: std_10
features.meaning: 10-day rolling standard deviation of raw closing price.
features.interpretation: Price-level dependent (not scale-invariant) — prefer rolling_volatility_* for cross-ticker comparisons.
features.limitations: Scale depends on the ticker's price level.

features.name: variance_10
features.meaning: 10-day rolling variance of raw closing price (std_10 squared).
features.interpretation: Same information as std, in squared units.

features.name: std_20
features.meaning: 20-day rolling standard deviation of raw closing price.
features.interpretation: Price-level dependent (not scale-invariant) — prefer rolling_volatility_* for cross-ticker comparisons.
features.limitations: Scale depends on the ticker's price level.

features.name: variance_20
features.meaning: 20-day rolling variance of raw closing price (std_20 squared).
features.interpretation: Same information as std, in squared units.

features.name: bollinger_middle
features.meaning: Center line of the Bollinger Bands.
features.interpretation: Same as sma_20 by default; the trend baseline the bands are drawn around.

features.name: bollinger_upper
features.meaning: Upper volatility band.
features.interpretation: Price reaching/exceeding this band suggests a statistically stretched move.

features.name: bollinger_lower
features.meaning: Lower volatility band.
features.interpretation: Price reaching/exceeding this band suggests a statistically stretched downside move.

features.name: bollinger_bandwidth
features.meaning: Normalized band width — a direct volatility measure.
features.interpretation: A tight bandwidth ('squeeze') often precedes a sharp directional move.
features.when_to_use: Volatility-regime / breakout-anticipation feature.

features.name: bollinger_percent_b
features.meaning: Where price sits within the bands, normalized 0-1 (can exceed the range on breakouts).
features.interpretation: %B near 1 = near the upper band; near 0 = near the lower band; >1 or <0 = outside the bands.
features.limitations: Undefined (NaN) when the bands have zero width (flat price); guarded against divide-by-zero.

features.name: macd_line
features.meaning: Difference between the fast and slow EMA.
features.interpretation: Positive = fast EMA above slow EMA (bullish momentum); negative = bearish momentum.
features.advantages: Combines trend and momentum in one line; widely used and well understood.
features.limitations: Lagging (built from EMAs); less useful in strongly sideways/choppy markets.
features.when_to_use: Trend-momentum confirmation alongside RSI.

features.name: macd_signal
features.meaning: Smoothed trigger line for the MACD line.
features.interpretation: Crossovers of macd_line above/below macd_signal are classic buy/sell triggers.

features.name: macd_histogram
features.meaning: Distance between the MACD line and its signal line.
features.interpretation: Sign shows which side of the crossover price is on; magnitude shows momentum strength; shrinking histogram often precedes a crossover.
features.when_to_use: Early-warning feature for upcoming MACD crossovers.

features.name: volume_rolling_mean_10
features.meaning: 10-day average trading volume.
features.interpretation: Baseline 'normal' volume for the ticker; compare current volume against it.

features.name: volume_rolling_std_10
features.meaning: 10-day volume volatility.
features.interpretation: High values indicate erratic/event-driven trading activity.

features.name: volume_rolling_mean_20
features.meaning: 20-day average trading volume.
features.interpretation: Baseline 'normal' volume for the ticker; compare current volume against it.

features.name: volume_rolling_std_20
features.meaning: 20-day volume volatility.
features.interpretation: High values indicate erratic/event-driven trading activity.

features.name: volume_change
features.meaning: Day-over-day percentage change in volume.
features.interpretation: Spikes often coincide with news/earnings events.

features.name: volume_ratio
features.meaning: Today's volume relative to its recent average.
features.interpretation: Ratio > 1.5-2x is commonly used as a 'high conviction' participation threshold (see breakout features).

features.name: vwap
features.meaning: Volume-Weighted Average Price, cumulative from the start of the loaded series.
features.interpretation: Price above VWAP suggests buyers are in control on average; a common institutional execution benchmark.
features.limitations: Cumulative-from-series-start VWAP is most meaningful intraday; for daily bars, treat it as a long-run reference line rather than a session VWAP.
features.when_to_use: Reference level for whether current price is 'expensive' or 'cheap' relative to volume-weighted history.

features.name: obv
features.meaning: On-Balance Volume — running total that adds volume on up days and subtracts it on down days.
features.interpretation: Rising OBV alongside rising price confirms the trend; OBV diverging from price can flag weakening trends.
features.limitations: A cumulative indicator — its absolute level is arbitrary; only its slope/divergence from price is meaningful.

features.name: rolling_mean_5
features.meaning: Rolling 5-day average of closing price.
features.interpretation: General-purpose descriptive statistic; combined with the current close it lets a model infer relative positioning cheaply.
features.when_to_use: Feed as raw model-agnostic inputs to tree-based ML (Random Forest / XGBoost), which can learn nonlinear combinations on its own.

features.name: close_lag_1
features.meaning: Close value from 1 day(s) ago.
features.interpretation: Gives non-sequential models (e.g. Random Forest) direct access to recent history.
features.limitations: Redundant for LSTM/GRU, which already consume sequences (FR-5.4) — only needed for non-sequential models.
features.when_to_use: Tabular ML models (Random Forest, XGBoost, Linear Regression).

features.name: year
features.meaning: Calendar year.
features.interpretation: Lets a model learn long-run/macro regime effects.

features.name: quarter
features.meaning: Calendar quarter (1-4).
features.interpretation: Captures earnings-season/quarter-end effects.

features.name: month
features.meaning: Calendar month (1-12).
features.interpretation: Captures seasonal patterns (e.g. 'January effect').

features.name: week
features.meaning: ISO calendar week number.
features.interpretation: Finer-grained seasonality than month.

features.name: day
features.meaning: Day of month (1-31).
features.interpretation: Captures monthly cyclicality (e.g. payday effects).

features.name: day_of_week
features.meaning: Day of the trading week.
features.interpretation: Captures day-of-week effects (e.g. 'Monday effect').

features.name: is_month_end
features.meaning: True on the last calendar day of the month.
features.interpretation: Flags potential month-end rebalancing flow.

features.name: is_month_start
features.meaning: True on the first calendar day of the month.
features.interpretation: Flags potential start-of-month flow.

features.name: is_quarter_end
features.meaning: True on the last calendar day of the quarter.
features.interpretation: Flags potential quarter-end/earnings-adjacent effects.

features.name: higher_high
features.meaning: Today's high exceeded yesterday's high.
features.interpretation: Building block of uptrend structure.

features.name: higher_low
features.meaning: Today's low exceeded yesterday's low.
features.interpretation: Building block of uptrend structure.

features.name: lower_high
features.meaning: Today's high is below yesterday's high.
features.interpretation: Building block of downtrend structure.

features.name: lower_low
features.meaning: Today's low is below yesterday's low.
features.interpretation: Building block of downtrend structure.

features.name: inside_bar
features.meaning: Today's range is fully contained within yesterday's range.
features.interpretation: Often signals consolidation/indecision before a breakout.

features.name: outside_bar
features.meaning: Today's range fully engulfs yesterday's range.
features.interpretation: Signals a volatility expansion / potential reversal bar.

features.name: is_doji
features.meaning: Open and close are nearly equal.
features.interpretation: Indecision; often precedes a reversal, especially after a strong trend.

features.name: is_bullish_engulfing
features.formula: Bearish candle followed by a bullish candle whose body engulfs it
features.meaning: Two-candle bullish reversal pattern.
features.interpretation: Stronger when it occurs after a downtrend / at support.

features.name: is_bearish_engulfing
features.formula: Bullish candle followed by a bearish candle whose body engulfs it
features.meaning: Two-candle bearish reversal pattern.
features.interpretation: Stronger when it occurs after an uptrend / at resistance.

features.name: is_pin_bar
features.formula: One wick >= 2x body and the opposite wick <= body
features.meaning: Long single-sided wick, small body/opposite wick.
features.interpretation: Rejection of price at the wick's extreme; potential reversal.

features.name: is_hammer
features.formula: Long lower wick >= 2x body, small/no upper wick
features.meaning: Bullish reversal candle after a decline.
features.interpretation: Buyers rejected lower prices within the session.

features.name: is_shooting_star
features.formula: Long upper wick >= 2x body, small/no lower wick
features.meaning: Bearish reversal candle after an advance.
features.interpretation: Sellers rejected higher prices within the session.

features.name: is_marubozu
features.formula: Wicks <= 5% of the candle's range on both ends
features.meaning: Full-bodied candle with virtually no wicks.
features.interpretation: Strong one-sided conviction for the full session.

features.name: trend_strength
features.meaning: Signed fraction of the day's range captured by the candle body.
features.interpretation: Near +1/-1 = strong directional conviction; near 0 = indecisive session.

features.name: swing_high
features.formula: High(t) is the max High within +/-5 bars
features.meaning: Local price peak (fractal high).
features.interpretation: Used as pivot points for support/resistance and structure features.
features.limitations: Repaints: only confirmed once the trailing lookback window of future bars exists.
features.when_to_use: Offline feature engineering / backtesting, not real-time signal generation without an added lag.

features.name: swing_low
features.formula: Low(t) is the min Low within +/-5 bars
features.meaning: Local price trough (fractal low).
features.interpretation: Used as pivot points for support/resistance and structure features.
features.limitations: Repaints (see swing_high).
features.when_to_use: Offline feature engineering / backtesting.

features.name: break_of_structure_up
features.meaning: Price broke above the last significant swing high.
features.interpretation: Continuation signal in an uptrend.

features.name: break_of_structure_down
features.meaning: Price broke below the last significant swing low.
features.interpretation: Continuation signal in a downtrend.

features.name: change_of_character
features.formula: A break-of-structure opposite to the prevailing BOS direction
features.meaning: First structural break against the prevailing trend.
features.interpretation: Early warning of a potential trend reversal.

features.name: price_action_label
features.formula: first matching candlestick pattern in priority order, else 'None'
features.meaning: Single human-readable label summarizing today's candlestick pattern.
features.interpretation: Convenience categorical for reports/dashboards; the underlying boolean columns are more precise for modeling.

features.name: static_support
features.meaning: Simple rolling floor of recent price action.
features.interpretation: A break below this level suggests the recent trading range has failed.

features.name: static_resistance
features.meaning: Simple rolling ceiling of recent price action.
features.interpretation: A break above this level suggests the recent trading range has failed to the upside.

features.name: dynamic_support
features.formula: Price of the most recent confirmed swing_low
features.meaning: Structure-based (fractal) support level.
features.interpretation: More reactive than static_support to the most recent meaningful pivot.

features.name: dynamic_resistance
features.formula: Price of the most recent confirmed swing_high
features.meaning: Structure-based (fractal) resistance level.
features.interpretation: More reactive than static_resistance to the most recent meaningful pivot.

features.name: nearest_support
features.meaning: Alias exposed under the spec's requested column name.
features.interpretation: See dynamic_support.

features.name: nearest_resistance
features.meaning: Alias exposed under the spec's requested column name.
features.interpretation: See dynamic_resistance.

features.name: support_distance
features.meaning: Normalized distance from price to the nearest support.
features.interpretation: Small/near-zero = price is testing support right now (elevated bounce-or-break risk).

features.name: resistance_distance
features.meaning: Normalized distance from price to the nearest resistance.
features.interpretation: Small/near-zero = price is testing resistance right now.

features.name: swing_zone_width
features.meaning: Width of the current support-resistance trading range, normalized by price.
features.interpretation: Narrow = tight range (potential breakout setup); wide = range-bound with room to move.

features.name: demand_zone
features.formula: swing_low followed by a strong up-move within the lookback window (see module docstring)
features.meaning: Origin bar of a fresh institutional-style demand (buy-side) zone.
features.interpretation: Price returning to this zone is expected to find buying interest.
features.limitations: Heuristic, not a formally standardized indicator; forward-looking by construction (repaints).

features.name: supply_zone
features.formula: swing_high followed by a strong down-move within the lookback window
features.meaning: Origin bar of a fresh supply (sell-side) zone.
features.interpretation: Price returning to this zone is expected to find selling interest.
features.limitations: Heuristic; repaints (see demand_zone).

features.name: demand_zone_strength
features.formula: Forward % move away from the demand zone origin
features.meaning: How strong the reaction away from the zone was.
features.interpretation: Larger = more significant zone.

features.name: supply_zone_strength
features.formula: Forward % move away from the supply zone origin
features.meaning: How strong the reaction away from the zone was.
features.interpretation: Larger = more significant zone.

features.name: zone_width
features.formula: High - Low of the zone origin bar
features.meaning: Price band width of the zone.
features.interpretation: Narrower zones are considered more precise reaction levels.

features.name: demand_zone_age
features.formula: bars since the last demand_zone bar
features.meaning: Recency of the most recent demand zone.
features.interpretation: Smaller = more recently formed.

features.name: supply_zone_age
features.formula: bars since the last supply_zone bar
features.meaning: Recency of the most recent supply zone.
features.interpretation: Smaller = more recently formed.

features.name: fresh_demand_zone
features.meaning: Whether the nearest demand zone is still considered 'fresh' (untested).
features.interpretation: Fresh zones are traditionally considered more reliable than repeatedly-tested ones.

features.name: fresh_supply_zone
features.meaning: Whether the nearest supply zone is still considered 'fresh' (untested).
features.interpretation: See fresh_demand_zone.

features.name: nearest_demand_zone
features.formula: Low of the most recent demand_zone origin bar
features.meaning: Price level of the nearest demand zone floor.
features.interpretation: Reference level for support-style reactions.

features.name: nearest_supply_zone
features.formula: High of the most recent supply_zone origin bar
features.meaning: Price level of the nearest supply zone ceiling.
features.interpretation: Reference level for resistance-style reactions.

features.name: demand_zone_retested
features.formula: price re-enters the demand zone band after formation
features.meaning: Whether today's bar dipped back into an existing demand zone.
features.interpretation: A retest that holds strengthens the zone; a retest that fails (closes through) invalidates it.

features.name: supply_zone_retested
features.formula: price re-enters the supply zone band after formation
features.meaning: Whether today's bar pushed back into an existing supply zone.
features.interpretation: See demand_zone_retested.

features.name: fib_236
features.meaning: 23.6% Fibonacci retracement level of the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common area for a pullback within the prevailing trend to find support/resistance.
features.limitations: Only as reliable as the underlying swing points (dynamic_support/dynamic_resistance), which repaint.

features.name: fib_382
features.meaning: 38.2% Fibonacci retracement level of the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common area for a pullback within the prevailing trend to find support/resistance.
features.limitations: Only as reliable as the underlying swing points (dynamic_support/dynamic_resistance), which repaint.

features.name: fib_50
features.meaning: 50.0% Fibonacci retracement level of the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common area for a pullback within the prevailing trend to find support/resistance.
features.limitations: Only as reliable as the underlying swing points (dynamic_support/dynamic_resistance), which repaint.

features.name: fib_618
features.meaning: 61.8% Fibonacci retracement level of the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common area for a pullback within the prevailing trend to find support/resistance.
features.limitations: Only as reliable as the underlying swing points (dynamic_support/dynamic_resistance), which repaint.

features.name: fib_786
features.meaning: 78.6% Fibonacci retracement level of the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common area for a pullback within the prevailing trend to find support/resistance.
features.limitations: Only as reliable as the underlying swing points (dynamic_support/dynamic_resistance), which repaint.

features.name: fib_1272
features.meaning: 1.272 Fibonacci extension level beyond the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common projected target if the prevailing trend continues past the recent swing high.

features.name: fib_1618
features.meaning: 1.618 Fibonacci extension level beyond the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common projected target if the prevailing trend continues past the recent swing high.

features.name: fib_2618
features.meaning: 2.618 Fibonacci extension level beyond the current swing range.
features.interpretation: A common projected target if the prevailing trend continues past the recent swing high.

features.name: distance_from_fibonacci
features.meaning: Normalized distance from price to the nearest Fibonacci level.
features.interpretation: Near zero = price is sitting right on a Fibonacci level.

features.name: closest_fibonacci_level
features.meaning: Name of the nearest Fibonacci level.
features.interpretation: Categorical feature identifying which level price is currently reacting to.

features.name: fibonacci_confluence
features.formula: any fib level within 1.5% of static_support/static_resistance
features.meaning: A Fibonacci level lines up with an independent support/resistance level.
features.interpretation: Confluence of multiple methods at the same price is traditionally considered a stronger level.

features.name: trend_score
features.formula: OLS slope of Close over last 20 bars * window, in rolling-std units
features.meaning: Normalized trend strength and direction.
features.interpretation: Positive = uptrend, negative = downtrend; magnitude = conviction, comparable across tickers.
features.limitations: A regression slope treats the window as linear — doesn't capture curvature/acceleration.

features.name: trend_label
features.formula: Uptrend if trend_score > 1, Downtrend if < -1, else Sideways
features.meaning: Categorical trend regime.
features.interpretation: Direct, human-readable trend classification.

features.name: is_uptrend
features.meaning: Boolean uptrend flag.
features.interpretation: One-hot-style flag for tree models.

features.name: is_downtrend
features.meaning: Boolean downtrend flag.
features.interpretation: One-hot-style flag for tree models.

features.name: is_sideways
features.meaning: Boolean sideways/range-bound flag.
features.interpretation: One-hot-style flag for tree models.

features.name: trend_reversal_signal
features.formula: trend_label flips between Uptrend and Downtrend, or change_of_character is True
features.meaning: A structural or regression-based trend change just occurred.
features.interpretation: Early-warning flag; combine with volume confirmation before acting on it.

features.name: higher_high_count
features.formula: count of Higher Highs among the last 4 confirmed swing highs
features.meaning: How many of the recent swing highs were higher than the swing high before them.
features.interpretation: Higher counts support an uptrend classification (Dow Theory).

features.name: lower_high_count
features.formula: count of Lower Highs among the last 4 confirmed swing highs
features.meaning: How many recent swing highs were lower than the one before them.
features.interpretation: Higher counts support a downtrend classification.

features.name: higher_low_count
features.formula: count of Higher Lows among the last 4 confirmed swing lows
features.meaning: How many recent swing lows were higher than the one before them.
features.interpretation: Higher counts support an uptrend classification.

features.name: lower_low_count
features.formula: count of Lower Lows among the last 4 confirmed swing lows
features.meaning: How many recent swing lows were lower than the one before them.
features.interpretation: Higher counts support a downtrend classification.

features.name: bullish_structure
features.formula: most recent swing is both a Higher High and a Higher Low
features.meaning: Textbook Dow Theory uptrend confirmation.
features.interpretation: True = structure currently supports an uptrend read.

features.name: bearish_structure
features.formula: most recent swing is both a Lower High and a Lower Low
features.meaning: Textbook Dow Theory downtrend confirmation.
features.interpretation: True = structure currently supports a downtrend read.

features.name: market_bias
features.formula: Bullish if bullish_structure, Bearish if bearish_structure, else Neutral
features.meaning: Categorical summary of current market structure.
features.interpretation: Human-readable structure-based bias, independent of trend_label's regression approach.

features.name: market_structure
features.meaning: Alias exposed under the spec's requested column name.
features.interpretation: See market_bias.

features.name: breakout_above_resistance
features.meaning: Price closed above the prior rolling resistance level.
features.interpretation: Potential start of a new upward move.
features.limitations: A single close above resistance is a weak signal alone — check volume_confirmation.

features.name: breakdown_below_support
features.meaning: Price closed below the prior rolling support level.
features.interpretation: Potential start of a new downward move.

features.name: volume_confirmation
features.meaning: Whether today's volume was elevated enough to trust a breakout.
features.interpretation: True = the move had above-average participation.

features.name: fake_breakout
features.formula: breakout occurred but the very next close fell back inside the level
features.meaning: A breakout that failed to hold.
features.interpretation: Common trap for naive breakout strategies; finalizes one bar after the breakout bar.
features.limitations: Uses the next bar's close, so this label is only known one day later — not usable as a same-day live feature.

features.name: breakout_label
features.formula: categorical combination of breakout direction + volume_confirmation + fake_breakout
features.meaning: Human-readable summary of the day's breakout status.
features.interpretation: One of: None, Confirmed/Unconfirmed Breakout Up, Confirmed/Unconfirmed Breakdown, Fake Breakout.

features.name: support_bounce
features.formula: price within 1.5% of static_support and closed bullish, without breaking down
features.meaning: Price tested support and reacted upward.
features.interpretation: Supports a 'buy the dip' read at a known level.

features.name: resistance_rejection
features.formula: price within 1.5% of static_resistance and closed bearish, without breaking out
features.meaning: Price tested resistance and reacted downward.
features.interpretation: Supports a 'fade the rally' read at a known level.

features.name: demand_zone_bounce
features.formula: Low dipped into the nearest demand zone and the bar closed bullish
features.meaning: Price reacted upward from a demand zone.
features.interpretation: Zone-based analogue of support_bounce.

features.name: supply_zone_rejection
features.formula: High pushed into the nearest supply zone and the bar closed bearish
features.meaning: Price reacted downward from a supply zone.
features.interpretation: Zone-based analogue of resistance_rejection.

features.name: target_1_day
features.meaning: Raw future closing price 1 day(s) ahead.
features.interpretation: Regression label; NaN for the last few rows where the future isn't known yet.
features.when_to_use: Direct regression target for price-level prediction models.

features.name: future_return_1_day
features.meaning: Percentage return over the next 1 day(s).
features.interpretation: Scale-invariant regression label, comparable across tickers.
features.when_to_use: Preferred regression target over raw price for cross-ticker models.

features.name: target_direction_1_day
features.meaning: Binary up/down direction over the next 1 day(s).
features.interpretation: True = price rose; False = price fell or was flat.
features.when_to_use: Classification target for Buy/Hold/Sell-style signal models.

features.name: target_regression_1_day
features.meaning: Alias of future_return, named explicitly as the regression target per spec.
features.interpretation: Identical values to future_return_*_day.

features.name: target_3_day
features.meaning: Raw future closing price 3 day(s) ahead.
features.interpretation: Regression label; NaN for the last few rows where the future isn't known yet.
features.when_to_use: Direct regression target for price-level prediction models.

features.name: future_return_3_day
features.meaning: Percentage return over the next 3 day(s).
features.interpretation: Scale-invariant regression label, comparable across tickers.
features.when_to_use: Preferred regression target over raw price for cross-ticker models.

features.name: target_direction_3_day
features.meaning: Binary up/down direction over the next 3 day(s).
features.interpretation: True = price rose; False = price fell or was flat.
features.when_to_use: Classification target for Buy/Hold/Sell-style signal models.

features.name: target_regression_3_day
features.meaning: Alias of future_return, named explicitly as the regression target per spec.
features.interpretation: Identical values to future_return_*_day.

features.name: target_5_day
features.meaning: Raw future closing price 5 day(s) ahead.
features.interpretation: Regression label; NaN for the last few rows where the future isn't known yet.
features.when_to_use: Direct regression target for price-level prediction models.

features.name: future_return_5_day
features.meaning: Percentage return over the next 5 day(s).
features.interpretation: Scale-invariant regression label, comparable across tickers.
features.when_to_use: Preferred regression target over raw price for cross-ticker models.

features.name: target_direction_5_day
features.meaning: Binary up/down direction over the next 5 day(s).
features.interpretation: True = price rose; False = price fell or was flat.
features.when_to_use: Classification target for Buy/Hold/Sell-style signal models.

features.name: target_regression_5_day
features.meaning: Alias of future_return, named explicitly as the regression target per spec.
features.interpretation: Identical values to future_return_*_day.
